They must be mapped to defined metrics such as Driver Hourly Earnings plus driver retention, or On-Time Delivery Rate.","evidence_quote":"- Driver happiness: improve.\n- Faster handoffs: improve.","citations":["metrics-glossary#deprecated-and-ambiguous-terms"],"recommendation":"Replace with canonical metrics (e.g., Driver Hourly Earnings plus driver retention; On-Time Delivery Rate or Promise Accuracy) as defined in the glossary."},{"type":"NO_BASELINE_TARGET","title":"Success metrics lack baseline, target and timeframe","detail":"Both success metrics only say \"improve\" with no baseline value, numeric target, or timeframe, so success cannot be judged.","evidence_quote":"- Driver happiness: improve.\n- Faster handoffs: improve.","citations":[],"recommendation":"State the baseline, a numeric target, and a timeframe for each success metric."},{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Does not reference EXP-040 learning on pickup readiness","detail":"EXP-040 on pickup wait concluded that pickup readiness should be fixed rather than compensated. The proposal addresses pickup readiness but does not reference or build on that experiment.","evidence_quote":"Drivers report frustration when orders are not ready at pickup.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-040-pickup-wait-compensation"],"recommendation":"Cite EXP-040, explain how this proposal follows its learning, and use its results (Driver Acceptance Rate, Cost Per Delivery) as a reference point."}]}
